map.儿童牙弓（长度/宽度）发育 使用指南: Pediatric Dental Arch (length / width) Development User Guide
map.输入儿童年龄与牙弓测量值，对照各年龄段牙弓长度与宽度的参考范围，评估颌骨发育是否: Enter the child's age and arch measurements and compare against the reference ranges of arch length and width for each age group to assess whether jaw development is normal, for orthodontic screening reference.
map.替牙期牙弓宽度偏窄，对照年龄参考范围，工具提示潜在拥挤风险与扩弓窗口。: Narrow arch width during the mixed dentition period, compared against age reference ranges; the tool flags potential crowding risk and the expansion window.
map.牙弓长度不足致前牙拥挤，量化与同年龄均值的差距。: Insufficient arch length causes anterior crowding; quantify the gap against the same-age mean.
map.定期复测牙弓生长曲线，监测发育趋势。（结果仅供口腔健康科普与自我初筛参考，不替代: Re-measure the arch growth curve periodically to monitor development trend. (Results are for oral health education and self-screening reference only, not a substitute for oral examination, periapical films/CBCT and other imaging assessment, or professional diagnosis and treatment by dentists, orthodontists and periodontists; for toothache, bleeding gums, ulcers that will not heal, abnormal oral mucosa or bite discomfort, see a stomatology department promptly.)
map.：输入：年龄 9 岁，上颌牙弓宽度 31mm，同龄参考 34±1.5mm\n判定:
: input: age 9, maxillary arch width 31 mm, same-age reference 34 ± 1.5 mm
Judgment: about 3 mm below the mean, suggesting a narrow arch and higher crowding risk, so orthodontic screening is advised.
map.正畸力与牙移动评估器: Orthodontic Force and Tooth Movement Assessor
map.牙周袋深度与附着丧失评估器: Periodontal Pocket Depth and Attachment Loss Assessor
map.牙弓参考范围怎么来的？: Where do the arch reference ranges come from?
map.来自儿童牙颌发育流行病学统计，按年龄/性别分层的均值区间；个体差异大，仅作初筛参: From epidemiological statistics of pediatric dental and jaw development, mean ranges stratified by age and sex; individual variation is large, so it is only a screening reference.
map.牙弓窄一定要扩弓吗？: Does a narrow arch always need expansion?
map.不一定。轻度可在替牙期观察，明显骨性狭窄可在生长高峰扩弓；由正畸科医师结合全景片: Not necessarily. Mild cases can be watched during the mixed dentition period, and clear skeletal narrowing can be expanded during the growth peak; the orthodontist judges with a panoramic film.
map.多久测一次？: How often should it be measured?
map.替牙期建议每 6~12 个月复查牙弓与间隙；本工具仅为趋势参考，不替代定期口腔检: During the mixed dentition period, recheck the arch and spacing every 6 to 12 months; this tool is only a trend reference and does not replace regular dental check-ups.
